baseline.note: Asset is frozen. Only the SHVDN driver changes (X3 superset of the X2 driver). No threshold below may change after any X3 result is seen.

conditions.ISO: SHVDN AutoLoadScripts=false (hash-backed temporary change), only WpsBreachLab started through the SHVDN console; existing ASI mods remain.
conditions.MOD: Unmodified loader (AutoLoadScripts=true); WpsBreachLab auto-loads beside the installed script mods. Representative-stack condition, reported separately and never pooled with ISO.
conditions.display: F6 pressed once after every launch (user's standing preference: turns DLSS5 off); recorded in the run log.

frameWindows.definition: Frame time = wall-clock Stopwatch delta between consecutive script resumptions (one per rendered frame) in windows that contain no shape tests. Game.LastFrameTime is logged alongside.

conditionalN.onlyIf: n=12 PASS with active P99 ratio <= 1.25 and max pool fraction <= 0.10

A_gates.replication: A practical limit is PROVEN only if the same n passes on a second fresh launch; otherwise PARTIAL.
A_gates.stopEscalation: First step that is UNSAFE or PERF_REGRESSION ends escalation; it is recorded as the first observed limit. No intentional crash search.

B_gates.traversalRecovery: Applies to initial class DEBRIS_OBSTRUCTED: post-management sweep window >= 0.6 AND NPC crosses inside the wall footprint.
B_gates.decisionRule: Recommended strategy = among strategies passing integrity and effectiveness in every trial, the one with the most debris-obstructed trials recovered; ties broken by smaller management frame spike, then fewer deletions.

D_definitions.baselineValid: 120/120 blocked cells, 0 clear swept columns, 20/20 anchor face hits, 0 failed ray requests
D_definitions.destructionSuccess: explosionDetected AND flaggedDetached >= 1 (explicit native detached-parent evidence)
D_definitions.openingAccuracy: distance in wall plane between the centroid of the largest 4-connected cleared component and the intended (du,height); accurate if <= 0.5 m. All-cleared-cell centroid distance is reported too.
D_definitions.strictLocality: UNCHANGED X2 definition: centroid of ALL clear cells in the first post-blast mask (cell centre u=-1.5+(i%12+.5)*.25, v=(i//12+.5)*.25) within 0.5 m of (du,height); trials without clear cells fail; gate >= 80% (M2).
D_definitions.traversalSuccess: sweep window >= 0.6 m (r=0.30 spheres at 0.5/0.9/1.3/1.7 m) AND NPC walk label 'crossed' with crossing inside the wall footprint. NPC walk is attempted when openedClear >= 4.

openingClassRules.INTACT: no baseline-solid cell lost root collision (rootRemoved == 0)
openingClassRules.DEBRIS_OBSTRUCTED: window < 0.6 AND cells blocked by detached debris >= 4 AND (clear + debris-blocked) >= 8
openingClassRules.ELEVATED: window < 0.6 AND largest clear component >= 4 cells AND its lowest row index >= 2 (bottom edge >= 0.5 m)
openingClassRules.NARROW: window < 0.6 AND largest clear component >= 4 cells AND lowest row index <= 1
openingClassRules.PARTIAL_OTHER: rootRemoved > 0 and none of the above

E_gates.playerDemonstration: Attended-style, computer-controlled key hold: one breach crossing and one intact-control block, judged by logged player coordinates.
E_gates.modStack: Representative stack run once as a separate condition; lab results are never generalised to it.

stopConditions: S1 crash/stall: process exit or heartbeat stale > 60 s without DONE -> preserve logs, diagnose, one diagnosed retry; a second crash in the same scenario STOPs that scenario.
S2 baseline invalid twice in the same condition -> diagnose before continuing.
S3 pool fraction > 0.5, any frame > 1000 ms, or script exception -> end escalation.
S4 any sign of a non-Story-Mode / network session -> abort immediately.
S5 restoration hash mismatch -> stop and report; never leave the install modified.
S6 more than 8 GTA launches in total -> stop, report PARTIAL.

launchPlan.L0: Shakedown (excluded from gates unless valid): compile/load, regression anchor, tool check.
launchPlan.L1: ISO: ambient, R0 regression, ladder A, rounds, soak, R-set #1
launchPlan.L2: ISO: debris-management matrix B (single-wall geometry + n=4 perf)
launchPlan.L4: ISO: R-set #3, full D matrix (3 positions x 3 charges x 2), player demonstration, ladder replication
